_note: Mechanics and narrative flavour. No rules text: setup steps name what to do
in a few words and point at cards by code, which the app resolves to real
card names. Someone without the campaign book cannot play from this file.
Card codes are MarvelCDB codes. They are stable and language-neutral, which
is why they are stored rather than names — the app shows the name.

notice.fr:
Campagne non officielle, reconstituée pour l'application : le livret et les cartes de la boîte Convoitise Galactique restent nécessaires pour jouer.

L'application tient la boutique et le registre à votre place : vos crédits et vos achats, les cartes joueur placées dans La Collection, les Artefacts Galactiques de votre pile de victoire, les jetons Fuite, et en campagne experte les points de vie de chaque héros entre les parties.
notice.en:
Unofficial, reconstructed for the app: the rulebook and cards from The Galaxy's Most Wanted box are still needed to play.

The app runs the market and keeps the log for you: your credits and purchases, the player cards put into The Collection, the Galactic Artifacts in your victory display, the escape tokens, and in an expert campaign each hero's hit points between games.
